audit.why: 54.87% over 421 games with a tricky 7.5/10 framing holds: Gnar owns levels 1-2 on range, the middle is Rage-bar dependent, and Poppy takes over at 2+ items when his mobility is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with both the packet chart and the mirror's already-applied group: Level 2 read Skill, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 read Poppy, Level 6 read Gnar, First item read Poppy.
audit.why: The mirror flipped exactly five rows as one atomic group and landed on the packet chart (Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Poppy). Poppy's own whys already described that chart — whys[2] 'it's a skill read', whys[3] 'even and matchup-dependent', whys[4] 'it cuts both ways', whys[5] 'keeping it close' — so only the side tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: phases[1..5].side and win[1..5] flipped together, Level 2 rated 3/10 (mirror's 7/10 inverted) and the four Skill rows 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was never stated: Gnar can cancel Keeper's Verdict with Wallop or GNAR!. Nothing on the page warned the player before spending a 140-second ultimate. Ability names were also generic ('boomerang', 'hop', 'Mega Stun') rather than Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Hop / Crunch, Hyper / Wallop.
audit.why: Poppy's R is flagged channel — any CC cancels it — and Gnar carries two hard-CC tools in Mega form. Conversely Steadfast Presence genuinely does eat Hop and Crunch, since both are dashes; that part of the page was correct and is kept, now with the 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s cooldown attached.
audit.corrected: Channel cancel stated in phases[4].why, spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1]; Hop's cooldown and the W interaction sharpened in tldr, dosFull[2].d, wants.you[0] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page named GNAR! as the cooldown to track. It is 90/60/30s and only exists in Mega form; the lane-defining timer is Hop.
audit.why: Hop at 22s rank 1 is his only escape and the thing W punishes. Boomerang Throw is 16s but refunds on catch, so it is unreliable to count.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d rebuilt around Hop, the Rage bar, and GNAR!'s real cooldown.
